ngaap.notes: Adjusted results (2021 definition) exclude: (1) restructuring & transaction costs (shown as one combined line; recorded in items.restructuring, items.transaction left null), (2) ALL non-cash intangible amortization expense (the add-back was already in place before 2021 — the 2020 comparative columns in these releases also add it back), and (3) foreign exchange gains/losses in other income (items.nonop, signed as added). Adjusted EBITDA excludes restructuring & transaction costs only. FY2021 adds 'Amended Return, net' (−$25m discrete tax benefit removed). Operating cash flow conversion 102% (CFO / (NI + D&A incl. deferred debt cost amortization 491)).
